issues.quote: - Window: `CUSTOM_TIME` or `WORKING_HOURS`, never `SILENT_HOURS`, inside 8 am to 9 pm customer local time; team timezone set (unset means UTC) (Q22).
issues.concern: WORKING_HOURS does not fit an after-hours window. It allows a text only inside the dealer's configured working hours, uses the working-hours timezone rather than the team timezone, and returns false on any non-working day or when working hours are unset. If the dealer's working hours are store hours, a lead forwarded after BDC close is skipped as stl-outside-working-hours, and every Sunday lead is skipped. It fails safe (no text, BDC calls), but step 0 could deliver nothing, and the 'team timezone set' check would not catch it because WORKING_HOURS never reads the team timezone.
issues.because: `conversational-ai-backend:src/speed-to-lead/services/speed-to-lead-console-call.service.ts:278` (moment.tz(workingTz)), `:303` (non-working day returns OUTSIDE_WORKING_HOURS), `:267` (missing hours or timezone returns false); team timezone used only for SILENT_HOURS and CUSTOM_TIME (`:216`)
issues.ask: Make the window `CUSTOM_TIME` only, evaluated in the team timezone (set, not UTC), with a window per day including closed days. If WORKING_HOURS is ever used, record the dealer's working days, hours and timezone at go-live and show that the step 0 window is inside them on every day.

issues.quote: The type entry the test lead resolves to must be on.
issues.concern: On is not enough. resolveStlGate runs evaluateConfigGate on the type entry with the type entry's own mode before it checks the source entry. If the resolved type entry ('empty', DEFAULT or a named type) is on with WORKING_HOURS or a daytime CUSTOM_TIME window set up for another feed, every after-hours lead is skipped with an stl-outside-* reason. Section 3 files stl-outside-* under 'Designed skips visible' with no target, so this misconfiguration would show up as an expected skip, not a defect.
issues.because: `conversational-ai-backend:src/speed-to-lead/services/speed-to-lead-console-call.service.ts:446`-`:470` (type gate evaluated with its mode, then source gate); section 3 'Designed skips visible' row
issues.ask: State that the resolved type entry must be on with mode FULLDAY or a window covering the source entry's window, record its mode at the production test, and count any stl-outside-* skip on a lead created inside the source window as a defect skip (target 0).

issues.quote: Before go-live the dealer sends one test inquiry from a staff phone to the real inbox, production config, nudge off, source not excluded.

The code also already answers A5's skip-or-hold question (skip, :1922), but nothing in production confirms it.
